title: Johnston Atoll National Wildlife Refuge
summary: Johnston Atoll National Wildlife Refuge is comprised of four islands (Johnston, Sand, North and East Island), and is located 716 nautical miles southwest of Honolulu. The formation of the atoll began 70 million years ago through a series of underwater volcanic eruptions. Johnston and Sand Island were designated as federal bird refuges in 1926 and retained its status as a refuge after the U.S. Navy
